name: MMCD Therapeutic Peptide Generator
description: Generate therapeutic peptide sequences with MMCD, optionally generating peptide backbone PDB structures or building structures from an uploaded FASTA file.
changelog: Initial ssh_job wrapper for MMCD peptide generation and optional structure generation with direct host IP and password authentication.

examples.name: FASTA 结构生成示例
examples.description: 使用内置 sequences.fasta，为示例多肽序列生成结构。

mode.title: Run mode
mode.description: peptide_generation generates new peptide sequences; structure_from_fasta generates PDB structures for an uploaded FASTA file.

fasta.title: Input FASTA
fasta.description: Required only when mode is structure_from_fasta.

checkpoint_preset.title: Checkpoint preset
checkpoint_preset.description: Default uses the main total-loss checkpoint. Structure uses the structure-prior checkpoint.

n_seq.title: Sequence count
n_seq.description: Number of peptide sequences to generate. Ignored for structure_from_fasta.

seq_batch_size.title: Sequence batch size
seq_batch_size.description: Batch size used by the sequence denoising sampler.

sampling_steps.title: Sampling steps
sampling_steps.description: Diffusion sampling steps. 50 is suitable for smoke tests; 1000 is the formal setting.

seq_sampling_profile.title: Sequence sampling profile
seq_sampling_profile.description: bare is the minimal sampler; enhanced enables legacy prior/property/repetition guards.

seq_temperature.title: Sequence temperature
seq_temperature.description: Sampling temperature for peptide sequence generation.

seq_top_k.title: Top-k
seq_top_k.description: Top-k sequence sampling filter. Use 0 to disable.

generate_structures.title: Generate PDB structures
generate_structures.description: When enabled, MMCD also samples peptide backbone structures. This is slower than sequence-only generation.

struct_postprocess.title: Structure postprocess
struct_postprocess.description: Optional postprocess applied during structure generation.

relax_steps.title: Relax steps
relax_steps.description: Relaxation steps when structure postprocess uses relax. 0 means model default.

device.title: Device
device.description: Runtime device. cuda:N sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=N and calls MMCD with cuda:0.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Random seed used for sequence and structure sampling.
